items.title: Prudential Financial (PRU) Will Exit Its Entire Alexander Forbes Stake
items.summary: Prudential Financial (NYSE:PRU) has announced plans to exit its entire investment in Alexander Forbes Group Holdings Limited. The exit forms part of Prudential Financial's wider move to withdraw from emerging markets and narrow its global footprint. The proposed transaction remains subject to shareholder and regulatory approvals before completion. items.summary: On September 18, Prudential Financial (NYSE:PRU) announced it will sell every share it holds in Alexforbes, a company listed on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange. Two buyers are splitting the stake. Alexforbes will repurchase roughly 372.8 million shares itself, and ARC AF Holdings will take about 74.1 million more.
